status: completed ordered-frame inspection; no repair demonstrated
method: Viewed every decoded video frame in consecutive contact sheets using the image-view tool, followed by enlarged PNG and donor-panel inspection. No real-time playback or artist approval.

mask_audit_examples.finding: The nominal iris/aperture region contains extensive bright sclera and adjacent skin. Bright exclusion does not remove all of it. Face-found is not an iris-validity check.

The nominal right iris region is dominated by sclera; the actual iris/reflection is displaced toward the left of the displayed patch. The surviving aperture must not be treated as known iris material.

Right compact candidates lie along the lower sclera/rim instead of the clearly visible upper softbox. Left aperture also clips the upper softbox. Confirms false candidates and omitted reflection extent on a target frame.

Both eyes visibly retain the softbox. The left compact detector produces no candidate despite its visible reflection; the conservative orange exclusion does cover it. A zero candidate count is not a reflection-free frame.

donor_findings: At source 820 left/right and source 779 right, displayed context-accepted aligned donors visibly retain softbox reflections over the outlined target region. Orange points mark unusable target-region samples. At source 721 neither eye has a donor within the individual <=2 context error gate; blank panels mean abstention.
hidden_control_findings: Some additional lower control patches receive support with the wide pool, but no consistent visible improvement is established. Both arms abstain during blinks and around the lower rim; local 67 is an explicit example. The original reflections remain visible, including local 120. These videos substitute only known hidden control pixels, never detected reflections.
limitations: This is a qualitative mask audit with explicit counterexamples, not pixel-labelled ground truth or a detector precision/recall estimate.
Overview thumbnails were resized and cannot establish subpixel fidelity. Enlarged source panels were inspected for the stated examples.
No hair, lip, source-occlusion or production-compositor treatment was made.
